item.title: Share your snow pictures with News 2
item.description: CHARLESTON, S.C. (WCBD) - Snow began falling across the Lowcountry on Saturday afternoon and will continue into the early morning. Be our reporter in your neighborhood: send us your photos and videos of the snow using the upload form below.

item.title: UPDATES: Snow and dangerous cold move into the Lowcountry
item.description: CHARLESTON, S.C. (WCBD) - Snow began falling across the Lowcountry on Saturday and will continue through the early morning hours. The winter weather could create hazardous road conditions through the early morning. Find live updates and the latest news information in our live blog here. ⤵

item.title: ‘Stay off the roads’: Law enforcement urging people to stay put at snow falls

item.title: Snow stops, but frigid temperatures continue across the Lowcountry
